summary: KT Corp filed a 6-K disclosing a board resolution to dispose 3,109 treasury shares at KRW 52,700 per share (closing price prior to resolution) via OTC sale, totaling ~KRW 164M. These shares are delivered to satisfy RSU grants, effectively a de minimis capital return event. The disposal occurs on July 24, 2026, authorized by the March 2026 key decision. Post-disposal treasury holdings remain substantial at 5.51% of total shares. This is equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K reporting a treasury share issuance for equity compensation. Not a broad buyback or tender offer; the amount is trivial relative to market cap. No premium, advisor, or regulatory clock applies; watch for tax treatment of RSU settlement in Korea.
